statement.notes: 1) 'Cash and cash equivalents' taken directly from the balance sheet line. 2) 'Marketable securities' mapped from 'Short-term investments' as the best match for liquid, short-term financial assets. 3) 'Accounts receivable' taken from the supplementary breakdown of 'Prepayments, receivables and other assets' (Note 13), specifically the 'Accounts receivable and contract assets (net)' line under the current portion. 4) 'Total current liabilities' taken directly from the balance sheet line. 5) 'Total debt short-term and long-term' calculated as the sum of: Short-term bank borrowings, Short-term unsecured senior notes, Long-term bank borrowings, Long-term unsecured senior notes, and Long-term convertible unsecured senior notes. 6) 'Total equity' taken directly from the 'Total equity' line on the balance sheet (which includes shareholders' equity and non-controlling interests). 7) 'Total assets' taken directly from the balance sheet line. 8) All values are in RMB millions (CNY) as per the primary statement columns. The USD columns were not used.
